title: Haven at Gulch Hotel Rooftop Pool & FREE Parking
description:
Welcome to The Gulch your ultimate Nashville retreat!  Designed with luxury & comfort in mind, this space is perfect for creating unforgettable memories

Our rates are set competitively to give guests excellent value. Book with us today and enjoy the peace of mind that your stay is confirmed and secure.

The space
Immerse yourself in the heart of the city, just steps away from 5-star dining, boutique shopping, Nissan Stadium & the Country Music Hall of Fame. Enjoy the walkable, vibrant neighborhood while relaxing in an artsy, calming environment crafted to elevate your experience whether you're here for a short escape or an extended stay.

Step into your ideal staycation, just steps from all the excitement in the heart of the city! Our luxurious unit is designed for your comfort, offering artsy bedrooms, a convenient pullout sofa, and a fully equipped kitchen to make you feel right at home. Whether you're visiting for a quick escape or an extended stay, our goal is for a calm & comfortable experience.

🏢 Building Amenities
✔Enjoy the perks of staying at Haven at The Gulch:
✔Rooftop terraces with city views
✔Infinity pool with lounge chairs
✔Fully equipped fitness center
✔Chef’s kitchen, game room & music studio
✔Community lounge, outdoor dining, and seating areas
✔Secure lobby, elevators, and welcoming common spaces

🛏 Master Bedroom
✔King bed with plush pillows & blackout shades for restful nights
✔55” Smart TV for your favorite shows
✔Dual nightstands & lamps for convenience
✔En suite bathroom and full closet with hangers
✔Iron and ironing board included

🛏 Guest Bedroom
✔Designed for comfort and versatility:
✔Two twin beds with cozy linens
✔55” Smart TV for entertainment
✔Vanity with lamp & makeup mirror
✔Full closet with hangers and blackout shades

🛋 Living Room
✔The heart of the home, perfect for relaxing or entertaining:
✔Queen pull-out sofa bed for extra guests
✔70” Smart TV + board & card games
✔Fun Nashville neon light and stylish wall art
✔Ottoman, stools, and bar seating for flexible lounging
✔In-unit washer and dryer for convenience

🍳 Fully Stocked Kitchen
✔Everything you need to cook, dine, and entertain:
✔Full-size fridge & freezer, stove, oven, and microwave
✔Toaster, pots & pans, cutting board, and essentials
✔Coffee maker with pods, wine glasses, plates, and silverware
✔Dining island with stools for casual meals

★The neighborhood — The Gulch
The Gulch is a LEED-certified, ultra-walkable neighborhood between Music Row and downtown — packed with standout restaurants, coffee shops, boutiques, murals, and live-music venues. You’ll be minutes from hotspot dining, popular bars, and within easy walking or a short ride of Broadway and the Music City Center. It’s one of Nashville’s trendiest, most connected areas for visitors
